core_obligations: Derive regularity of the ring from regularity of the completion (proof lines 10674-10675).

proof_roadmap: Dimension comparison and generator count (proof lines 10676-10680).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a Noetherian local ring is regular exactly when its completion is. One direction is quoted from the result that regularity descends along the flat completion map. For the other, the author uses that the dimension of the ring equals that of its completion, so the minimal number of generators of the maximal ideal of the ring equals the dimension of the completion, while the maximal ideal of the completion is generated by the extended maximal ideal and hence by at most that many elements; regularity of the completion follows. An alternative reference is also recorded.
